card.name: Removing packaging, liners and desiccant
card.fires_on: Words inside instructions for opening or unpacking a product, just before a packaging item such as liner, packet, cover, carton or filter needle. Typical cases are 'release', 'the', 'transparent' or part of 'desiccant' when a package part is being named or removed.

modes.label: Before a liner or cover
modes.description: Words like release, the, transparent or adhesive placed before liner, lining or cover in peel or remove steps.
modes.example: Peel away the<< adhesive>> liner on the On-body Infusor

modes.label: Inside packet item names
modes.description: Partway through names of small packaged items such as desiccant or oxygen scavenger packets.

modes.label: Before device parts in a kit
modes.description: Words like pre or transfer that come before syringe or filter needle in use-and-inspect instructions.
